lucy: Quick plan check  We have the "Optimizer Deep Dive" webinar Tuesday. Need X + LinkedIn cadence, seedlist split, and legal-approved benchmark phrasing. Short timeline.
omar: Suggested cadence: Mon APAC teaser, Tue announce, Tue live reminder (30m), Wed recap. X = short threads, LinkedIn = long announcement + CEO quote card.
dina: Creative checklist: hero (16:9), 25s autoplay clip, benchmark PNG, two quote cards, reg link with UTMs. I'll deliver assets by Thu EOB.
rafa: Seed routing: add tag=opt_deepdive_may. Tier A -> SDR Enterprise (24h follow), Tier B -> growth-nurture (48h). Include columns: email,name,company,title,score,vertical,tag,sdr_queue,priority,followup_by.
lucy: Copy variants please: LinkedIn short vs technical; X thread long vs concise. Legal: use "in our tests" or "up to" for numbers.
omar: Draft LinkedIn short: "See how teams cut inference cost and latency. Live demo + benchmark, May 19." Draft technical: "Runtime tweaks, batching, and quantization delivered ~2x latency improvement and ~35% lower token cost in our tests. Join demo."
dina: Uploading assets: https://drive.google.com/opt-deepdive-assets. Filenames: hero_deep.jpg, clip25.mp4, bench_deep.png, quote_ceo.png, quote_eng.png
queue-bot: Scheduled: X APAC teaser -> 2026-05-18T07:00:00Z (owner: omar); LinkedIn announce -> 2026-05-18T16:00:00Z (owner: dina); X reminder -> 2026-05-19T16:30:00Z (owner: dina).
rafa: For no-shows: tag CRM = no_show_opt19, automated email at 24h with recording link. SDR template for 24h follow-up: "Thanks for registering — quick Q: are you evaluating inference for product features?"
lucy: Seedlist owner? omar you take it and send CSV to rafa + dina by Fri 11am PT. Add `vertical` column.
omar: Will do. Also propose A/B captions for LinkedIn — two variants ready by Thurs.
dina: I'll A/B creative with hero crop and quote card. Swap if CTR on X < 0.5%.
lucy: Monitoring: first 12h post-launch — omar covers first 6, lucy next 6. Escalate any bench pushback to comms + legal.
rafa: I'll wire routing rules once I have the CSV and confirm SDR queue mappings.
lucy: Great. Next sync Thu 9am PT to lock assets + legal copy. Thanks team :tada:
omar: +1
dina: +1
